import asyncio
import importlib.metadata
from packaging.version import parse as parse_version
from client_module import client, app

async def test_real_asgi():
    httpx_ver = parse_version(importlib.metadata.version('httpx'))
    assert httpx_ver >= parse_version('0.28.0'), f'httpx must be >= 0.28.0, got {httpx_ver}'
    
    starlette_ver = parse_version(importlib.metadata.version('starlette'))
    assert starlette_ver >= parse_version('0.37.2'), f'starlette must be >= 0.37.2, got {starlette_ver}'

    async with client as c:
        res = await c.get('/')
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert res.text == 'ok'
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')

asyncio.run(test_real_asgi())
